name: Love Call
source:
Protagonist is a college student. One day he receives a call from a woman Cynthia, and that call brings numerous fears and mysteries to his life. She continues to call for the whole month drawing him into the world of dreams, magic and imagination.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名大学生。一天，他接到一名叫Cynthia的女子打来的电话，这通电话为他的生活带来无数恐惧和谜团。此后整整一个月，她不断来电，把他引入由梦境、魔法与想象构成的世界。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
